title: Fragments on 1 Corinthians
blurb: Cyril of Alexandria comments on Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians: the one Church called in every place, Christ the only foundation, marriage and the unmarried life, food offered to idols, the veiling of women, spiritual gifts, and the resurrection of the body. Only fragments of his commentary survive. A fresh English translation from the Greek.
first_english_note: A fresh English translation of Cyril’s fragments on 1 Corinthians, made from the Greek of PG 74. No modern English version was used as wording, and there is no ANF/NPNF English of this work.

text_history.method: Fresh English translation from the Greek of PG 74.

scope: The surviving fragments of Cyril’s commentary on 1 Corinthians, as printed in Migne, PG 74.
